title: Schoolchildren & Teachers, Brick Building - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor group portrait showing several children and adult women standing on a pathway in front of a single-story brick school or institutional building. The group includes young boys in high-waisted wide-leg trousers, a girl in a collared dress, and women dressed in Depression-era coats and day dresses. The architecture features modern masonry and multi-pane casement windows typical of mid-1930s public works or civic construction.
